paragraphs.text: A roof that keeps its snow all winter is often a sign of good insulation: heat is not escaping to melt it. Neighbours whose roofs are bare after a frost may be paying to warm the sky.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Snow is also a weight. A flat roof in a snowy region must carry about 200 kilograms on each square metre, and porches added later are the parts that fail most often.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Melting causes its own trouble. Water runs to the cold edge of the roof, freezes there and builds a ridge of ice, behind which meltwater backs up and finds its way under the tiles.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The old remedy was to climb up with a shovel. Builders now prefer to fix the cause: more insulation, better sealing of the loft hatch and vents that keep the roof space as cold as the air outside.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: A roof that keeps its snow all winter is often a sign of good insulation

explanation.en: Snow on the roof tells you about the insulation → i.
explanation.kk: Шатырдағы қар үйдің жылытылуы туралы айтады → i.
explanation.ru: Снег на крыше говорит об утеплении дома → i.

items.quote: must carry about 200 kilograms on each square metre

explanation.en: The paragraph is about load: 200 kilograms per square metre → ii.
explanation.kk: Абзац салмақ туралы: шаршы метрге 200 келі → ii.
explanation.ru: Абзац о нагрузке: 200 килограммов на квадратный метр → ii.

items.quote: freezes there and builds a ridge of ice

explanation.en: Ice at the edge and water under the tiles → iii.
explanation.kk: Шатыр шетіндегі мұз және тақтайша астындағы су → iii.
explanation.ru: Лёд у края крыши и вода под черепицей → iii.

items.quote: Builders now prefer to fix the cause

explanation.en: Treating the cause with insulation and vents instead of a shovel → iv.
explanation.kk: Себебін емдеу: күрек орнына жылыту мен желдету → iv.
explanation.ru: Лечить причину: утепление и вентиляция вместо лопаты → iv.
